Projects.title: Tyo Super Laundry Management System
desc: A laundry management system developed for Tyo Super Laundry to manage transactions and track laundry orders. The system includes a mobile application that notifies customers when their laundry is ready and integrates weather information to estimate laundry completion times based on weather conditions.

Projects.title: Village Digitalization Website
desc: A village digitalization platform developed during a four-month internship at CV Eksa Reka Cipta to digitize administrative processes and public services. The application features a multi-level user system for company administrators, village officers, and residents, along with digital letter requests, dynamic document numbering, PDF generation, real-time notifications, public complaints, social assistance tracking, and a village blog.

I independently handled the full-stack development, including the responsive interface, backend functionality, database integration, real-time features using Pusher, and deployment to a live hosting environment.

Projects.title: Kominfo Internship Participant Management Website
desc: An internship management system developed for the Dinas Komunikasi, Informatika, dan Persandian (Kominfo) Banyuwangi to digitize the management of internship applicants and replace the previous manual registration and monitoring process.

I developed the admin-side functionality, including applicant validation, mentor assignment with automatic workload distribution, centralized monthly and final report management, and a visual calendar for tracking internship schedules. The system also integrates WhatsApp-based OTP verification using the Fonnte API and was deployed using Nginx, PHP-FPM, and MySQL.

The application was validated through User Acceptance Testing (UAT), covering form validation, OTP authentication, and calendar and report functionality to ensure the system met the specified requirements.

Projects.title: PLN UP3 Banyuwangi Substation Inventory System
desc: A web- and mobile-based inventory system built to help PT PLN (Persero) UP3 Banyuwangi digitize substation asset management, replacing a manual, Excel-based recording process that caused data inconsistency and limited real-time access for field teams. The system integrates QR Code-based substation identification, location mapping, and centralized maintenance history tracking.

Designed for field reliability, the mobile app supports offline data recording with automatic synchronization once internet access is restored — built specifically for technicians working in low-connectivity substation locations. The system was validated through 100% success across 29 Black Box Testing scenarios and an 88.33% User Acceptance Testing score from PLN stakeholders.
